description:
Audit and expand the first-class Google Gemini surface using the provider-surface-rollout playbook. Improve the native generateContent lane, add the highest-value missing Google-native surfaces, add replay fixtures and sparse live verifiers, and reconcile support claims.

```mermaid
graph LR

    1 --> 3[expand built-in tools and validation]
```

title: Improve Google provider surface coverage
